text:
Type: green open cube bookcase
Use: holding books, toys and storage boxes, room divider; living room, playroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: painted board with a smooth uniform finish
Colors: vivid green, deep emerald shadows inside
Shape: tall boxy frame divided into a two-by-four grid of square cubbies, thick flat edges, open back usable from both sides, sturdy and chunky visual weight
Feel: bold, fun, energetic, fresh
Goes with: white or grey walls, natural wood, fabric bins, pops of color; modern, eclectic or children's rooms

product.name: KALLAX
product.description: You can use the furniture as a room divider because it looks good from every angle.
